title: Sync hosted rvl version and output schema for composite keys
description:
Rationale:
host-rvl pins rvl v0.5.1 and embeds a hand-copied rvl.v0 output schema. Current rvl key-mode output adds alignment.key_columns, contributor and field-change row_key arrays, and structured key arrays in refusal details.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Pin host-rvl to the first released rvl version containing bd-231 and report that exact version from tool_version and operator.json.
- Replace the embedded output schema with the exact schema emitted by that rvl release.
- Validate key_columns and optional row_key arrays, including a composite-key REAL_CHANGE payload and tuple-level refusal payload.
- Add a drift test that compares the embedded schema/manifest version to the pinned rvl dependency so future releases cannot silently diverge.
close_reason: Hosted rvl now pins and validates the released composite-key contract

comments.author: Zac
comments.text: Pinned host-rvl to immutable rvl v0.7.1 (locked at cca22f6e), updated tool_version/operator version, and replaced output-schema.json byte-for-byte with rvl 0.7.1 --schema. Added drift coverage across Cargo.toml tag, Cargo.lock source/version, tool_version, operator version, and composite schema fields. Added actual v0.7.1 composite REAL_CHANGE and E_KEY_DUP tuple-refusal schema validation. Gates: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --workspace --all-targets; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace (5 tests); UBS 0 critical (warnings are test assertions/expect calls).

title: Expose profile-backed composite keys through host-rvl requests
description:
Rationale:
host-rvl operator metadata advertises profile and profile_id, but RvlRequest accepts neither and only forwards the single-column key flag. Composite keys are profile-only in rvl, so hosted callers currently cannot use the capability.

Acceptance Criteria:
- Define a safe hosted profile input contract, preferably an uploaded profile artifact rather than access to host filesystem profile IDs.
- Materialize the profile inside the request sandbox and pass its path to rvl Args.
- Reject ambiguous key plus non-empty profile key through the normal rvl JSON refusal contract.
- Keep witness and network side effects disabled.
- Add end-to-end tests for a composite profile key, a missing profile key component, and a duplicate tuple.
- Make operator.json describe only request fields the host actually accepts.
close_reason: Hosted rvl now accepts sandboxed profile artifacts for composite keys with full refusal coverage

comments.author: Zac
comments.text: Added optional profile FileInput to RvlRequest with unknown-field rejection, sandboxed .yaml materialization, and explicit Args.profile wiring while forcing profile_id/capsule_out off and no_witness on. /describe now advertises only the eight accepted hosted request fields and identifies old/new/profile as artifact inputs. Added hosted end-to-end tests for composite alignment, E_NO_KEY missing component, E_KEY_DUP tuple refusal, and E_KEY_CONFLICT for key plus profile key; all payloads validate against the embedded rvl schema. Gates: cargo fmt --check; cargo check --workspace --all-targets; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace (10 tests total); UBS 0 critical (warnings are test assertions/expect calls).
